verdict.rationale: Maritime's own Files API can download an agent's disk over HTTP, even while the agent sleeps. Agents are standard Docker images speaking a three-endpoint contract, so data and workloads can be pulled out and run elsewhere. There is no documented account-wide export or open-format export of all user data, and the migration docs only cover moving onto Maritime, not leaving it. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export (agents, configs, logs, channels, triggers), stated open export formats, exit/offboarding documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: eight endpoints and both SDKs to browse, upload, download, and edit an agent's disk over HTTP, even while the agent sleeps
Any Docker container becomes an agent: three endpoints get you sleep/wake, channels, and triggers.
